Heart_disease_cleveland_new.label: Cleveland Heart Clinic Data
Heart_disease_cleveland_new.description: The primary benchmark dataset containing 303 clinical cases from the Cleveland Clinic Foundation. Used for initial model validation and clinical feature distribution analysis.

cleveland.description: Original raw data from the UCI repository. Contains 303 instances. The processed version is commonly used in clinical classification benchmarks.

cleveland_cleaned.description: Cleaned version of the Cleveland dataset with missing values handled and categorical variables prepared for machine learning pipelines.

hungarian.description: Clinical data collected by Andras Janosi, M.D. This cohort often shows different distribution patterns in fasting blood sugar and cholesterol compared to the Cleveland set.

switzerland.description: A challenging dataset due to a higher percentage of missing values in certain clinical features. It represents a European patient demographic.

long_beach.source: V.A. Medical Center, Long Beach, CA
long_beach.description: Clinical data provided by Robert Detrano, M.D., Ph.D. This dataset is part of the UCI heart disease collection and serves as a comparative West Coast cohort.

combined.description: A synthesized dataset combining clinical data from all four regional sources (Cleveland, Hungary, Switzerland, and Long Beach) to provide a more robust and diverse global training set.
